contracts.rule: If no test-like files or commands exist, score should not exceed 72.
Generic/low-context workspaces should not exceed 55 without a concrete product target.
Scores above 90 require both field signals and benchmark scenarios.
Scores above 74 require a CI or repeatable automation gate.
Scores above 78 require README/docs command truth or deep docs checks.
Scores above 86 require a named journey, e2e, scenario, or benchmark proof.
Scores above 88 require observability, status, telemetry, health, or field/error signals.
